description: Iron-chelation response in GSE256524: siderophore genes as positive control, hmg2 against an abundance-matched null
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

rpkm = pd.read_csv("GSE256524_full_rpkm_matrix.csv", index_col=0)
cols = list(rpkm.columns)
def grp(med, trt):
    return [c for c in cols if med in c and trt in c]
G = {"gluc_untr": [c for c in cols if "glucose+peptone untreated" in c],
     "gluc_DFP":  [c for c in cols if "glucose+peptone DFP" in c and "H2O2" not in c],
     "pep_untr":  [c for c in cols if c.split("Af293 ")[1].startswith("peptone untreated")],
     "pep_DFP":   [c for c in cols if c.split("Af293 ")[1].startswith("peptone DFP") and "H2O2" not in c]}
for k, v in G.items(): print(k, len(v))

L = np.log2(rpkm + 0.01)
def lfc_p(a, b):
    A, B = L[a].values, L[b].values
    t, p = stats.ttest_ind(B, A, axis=1, equal_var=False)
    return pd.Series(B.mean(1) - A.mean(1), index=L.index), pd.Series(p, index=L.index)

lfc_g, p_g = lfc_p(G["gluc_untr"], G["gluc_DFP"])
lfc_p_, p_p = lfc_p(G["pep_untr"], G["pep_DFP"])
base = rpkm[G["gluc_untr"] + G["pep_untr"]].mean(1)

# gene sets
gs = pd.read_csv("afumigatus_go_genesets_sid_erg.csv")
gs["key"] = gs["AFUA"].str.replace(r"AFUA_0*(\d+)G(\d+)", r"afu\1g\2", regex=True).str.lower()
sid = sorted(set(gs.loc[gs["set"].isin(["siderophore_biosynth", "TAFC_biosynth"]), "key"]) |
             {"afu3g03640", "afu3g03650", "afu3g03660", "afu3g03420", "afu1g17200", "afu5g11260"})
sid = [g for g in sid if g in L.index and g not in ("afu2g03700", "afu1g11230")]
erg = [g for g in sorted(set(gs.loc[gs["set"] == "ergosterol_biosynth", "key"]))
       if g in L.index and g not in ("afu2g03700", "afu1g11230")]
HMG1, HMG2 = "afu2g03700", "afu1g11230"
print("sid n=", len(sid), "erg n=", len(erg))

res = pd.DataFrame({"base_RPKM": base, "lfc_gluc": lfc_g, "p_gluc": p_g,
                    "lfc_pep": lfc_p_, "p_pep": p_p})
print("\n--- siderophore / TAFC genes, DFP vs untreated ---")
print(res.loc[sid].round(3).to_string())
print("\n--- hmg1 and hmg2 ---")
print(res.loc[[HMG1, HMG2]].round(3).to_string())
print("\nergosterol set median lfc: gluc %.2f  pep %.2f" % (res.loc[erg, "lfc_gluc"].median(), res.loc[erg, "lfc_pep"].median()))

# consistency: sign agreement across the two media
for lab, idx in [("siderophore/TAFC", sid), ("ergosterol", erg)]:
    s = res.loc[idx]
    agree = int(((s.lfc_gluc > 0) == (s.lfc_pep > 0)).sum())
    print(f"{lab}: {agree}/{len(s)} genes agree in sign between media; median |lfc| gluc {s.lfc_gluc.abs().median():.2f}")

# abundance-matched null for hmg2
lo, hi = base[HMG2] / 3, base[HMG2] * 3
null = res[(res.base_RPKM >= lo) & (res.base_RPKM <= hi)].drop(index=[HMG2], errors="ignore").dropna()
pct = stats.percentileofscore(null.lfc_gluc.abs(), abs(res.loc[HMG2, "lfc_gluc"]))
print(f"\nhmg2 base RPKM {base[HMG2]:.3f}; abundance-matched null n={len(null)} "
      f"(RPKM {lo:.3f}-{hi:.3f}); |lfc_gluc| percentile = {pct:.1f}")
print("null |lfc_gluc| 50th/75th/90th/95th:",
      np.round(np.percentile(null.lfc_gluc.abs(), [50, 75, 90, 95]), 2))
# cross-medium reproducibility by abundance
bins = pd.cut(np.log10(res.base_RPKM.clip(lower=1e-3)), [-3, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5, 4])
rep = res.dropna().groupby(bins, observed=True).apply(
    lambda d: pd.Series({"n": len(d), "r_between_media": np.corrcoef(d.lfc_gluc, d.lfc_pep)[0, 1]}))
print("\ncross-medium reproducibility of log2FC by abundance bin (log10 RPKM):")
print(rep.round(2).to_string())
res.to_csv("GSE256524_DFP_response_all_genes.csv")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
ax[0].scatter(res.lfc_gluc, res.lfc_pep, s=4, c="0.8", label="all genes")
ax[0].scatter(res.loc[sid, "lfc_gluc"], res.loc[sid, "lfc_pep"], s=42, c="#c0392b", label="siderophore / TAFC")
ax[0].scatter(res.loc[erg, "lfc_gluc"], res.loc[erg, "lfc_pep"], s=28, c="#2980b9", label="ergosterol")
ax[0].scatter(res.loc[HMG1, "lfc_gluc"], res.loc[HMG1, "lfc_pep"], s=110, c="k", marker="s", label="hmg1")
ax[0].scatter(res.loc[HMG2, "lfc_gluc"], res.loc[HMG2, "lfc_pep"], s=140, c="#f39c12", marker="*",
              edgecolor="k", label="hmg2")
ax[0].axhline(0, c="k", lw=.6); ax[0].axvline(0, c="k", lw=.6)
ax[0].set_xlabel("log2FC DFP vs untreated, glucose+peptone")
ax[0].set_ylabel("log2FC DFP vs untreated, peptone")
ax[0].set_title("Iron chelation response reproduces across media\nfor siderophore genes, not for hmg2")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right")

ax[1].hist(null.lfc_gluc, bins=40, color="0.8", edgecolor="0.5")
ax[1].axvline(res.loc[HMG2, "lfc_gluc"], c="#f39c12", lw=2.5,
              label=f"hmg2 ({res.loc[HMG2,'lfc_gluc']:.2f}, {pct:.0f}th pct)")
ax[1].set_xlabel("log2FC DFP vs untreated, glucose+peptone")
ax[1].set_ylabel("genes")
ax[1].set_title(f"hmg2 against an abundance-matched null\n(n={len(null)} genes, RPKM {lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f})")
ax[1].legend(fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
